entities.name: Hamad bin Thuwaini Al Busaidi

entities.summary: Sayyid Hamad bin Thuwaini Al-Busaidi was the fifth Sultan of Zanzibar. He ruled Zanzibar from 5 March 1893 to 25 August 1896.
